svg.aria-label: Perfect failure detector (P): With known bounds, silence for longer than the bounds allow can only mean a crash.. ⟨HEARTBEAT⟩ every period; heard within period + 2Δ + φ: alive; crash; the window passes with no heartbeat; suspect, and never take it back. Correct only because the model is timed: raise the delays above Δ and the perfect detector starts lying.
